newsitem.title: USA: American Freightways Q3 EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: American Freightways Q3 EPS below estimates.

text.p: American Freightways Corp said on Thursday that it believes its earnings per share for the quarter ending September 30 will be slightly over the $0.08 per share posted for the same period of 1995.
It added that analysts' consensus estimate for the quarter was $0.17 per share.
The company added that the restructuring of operations, though in its initial stages, shows promise of improving operations but may not positively influence net income this year.
The company said its on-time service is currently at 95 percent and headed higher. Yield, since August 1, is running approximately four percent over that of the same period last year.
American Freightways is a scheduled, for-hire carrier of less-than-truckload shipments of general commodities.
